writing.target: The journey to Grandma's house is long.
The film is two hours long.
Last summer, I travelled to|We went by|The journey took

text_en: Last summer, Nam's family travelled to the north of Vietnam.
They got up very early and took a taxi to the station.
The train left at a quarter past six, and it was on time.
Nam sat by the window and looked at the rice fields and mountains.
He ate snacks and played cards with his sister.
When they arrived, they took a bus to their hotel.
The next day, they went up a mountain in a cable car.
The view from the top was amazing!
Nam was tired, but he loved the trip.

questions.q: How did the family travel to the north?
How did they go up the mountain?
